description: Docker for AI agents — containers, compose stacks, logs and databases, locally or over SSH.
name: io.github.hypnosis/docker-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON file describing the Docker hosts this agent may reach. Without it the server answers about the Docker on this machine.
environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MCP_PROFILES_FILE

environmentVariables.description: The same profiles JSON inline, used when no profiles file is set.
environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_PROFILES

environmentVariables.description: Keep going when a profile's SSH key is missing, instead of refusing the profile. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MCP_ALLOW_SSH_FALLBACK

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info or debug. Defaults to info.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

title: Docker MCP Server
